annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it actively promotes participation through a sponsor-linked app download and a tutorial for exchanging PlusToken for Bitcoin. It directs viewers to select a PlusToken/BTC trade, enter an amount, and submit a sale, after which the speaker reports an increased displayed Bitcoin balance. The material attributes this promotion to the video itself rather than to reporting or criticism, without asserting a promised return, victim loss, or the behavior of the external download destination.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content links participation in PLUS token trading with exchange into Bitcoin and a displayed gain. The observed mechanism is token trading and an associated displayed appreciation/gain relationship, rather than a bot, funded contract, mining package, lending pool, or paid guidance service.
